scope: Only listed source ranges reviewed; unlisted source is not certified by this file. Insertion ownership, not runtime qualification.

reviewed_ranges.reason: LLWindowManager factory selects OS window only under use_gl; false selects headless. Add explicit backend/window mode; close/delete follows ownership; LLCoordGL conversions below are CPU coordinate conventions.

Virtual contract separates OS input/clipboard/gamma/size from GL shared-context/current-context/swap and opaque platform handle. Add typed handle and renderer lifecycle; LLCoordGL is CPU coordinates, not a context requirement.
Constructor owns window thread, keyboard/dragdrop/icons and display policy; unconditional opengl32 load and switchContext require backend gate. OS input/affinity/display setup remains platform-owned.

close shuts GL and WGL before wakeAndDestroy of HWND thread, then resets gamma. Native path must release swapchain/submitted consumers before HWND destruction; ordinary size/visibility methods stay OS-owned.

switchContext creates dummy/WGL pixel-format/context, reprobes GL and recreates HWND on owned window thread. Replace native mode lifecycle while retaining fullscreen/input; recreateWindow waits promise before publishing handle. Shared contexts are GL-only upload infrastructure.
SwapBuffers(mhDC) and Tracy GL collect are backend-specific presentation/profiling; Diligent Present plus backend-aware profiling replaces selected native path.
getPlatformWindow returns actual HWND, unlike SDL legacy handle; preserve owned lifetime and typed export.
Constructor ignores use_gl, creates GL context then gGLManager, cursors and X11 clipboard. Backend mode must separate SDL OS window and native resource creation; input/clipboard remain SDL/X11.

createContext sets SDL_WINDOW_OPENGL and SDL_GL attributes, creates GL context/surface-dependent fullscreen sizing, cached X11 handles, clear/present; switch destroys and reopens; destroyContext invalidates X11 and quits video. Native mode needs Vulkan flags, surface-independent dimensions, typed handles and swapchain retirement before SDL window/video teardown.
SDL_GL_SwapWindow is selected presentation seam; size/FSAA/gamma values are platform/future attachment policy, not native GL execution requirements.
getPlatformWindow NULL; add typed SDL WM export instead of legacy media handle; external-file launch remains OS functionality.
GL shared contexts, swap interval and make-current must stay only on GL path; native uploads use renderer ownership, not shared SDL GL contexts.
USE_SDL1 conditional legacy context rebuild and SDL video shutdown require explicit backend policy; no implicit native support from default SDL2 changes.
Legacy GTK/LLMOZLIB platform-window API returns GTK layout or NULL, not Vulkan Xlib surface; requires typed export if SDL1 tier supported.
SDL1 shared context methods only warn/return NULL; preserve conditional limitations, do not interpret as native-ready uploads.

Actual constructor only creates headless keyboard; swapBuffers empty. Factory headless mode is not a visible Vulkan window. Diagnostic offscreen target requires its own documented device/no-swapchain contract.
Headless virtual OS/context methods are no-ops/false/null and do not provide WSI. Preserve independently gated headless mode, no inference of a visible native viewer.

selectGLBackend only activates Zink GLVND environment under DISPLAY; initWindow restores it before helper process use. Native path must not activate GL provider environment; preserve reference/helper isolation.
selectGLBackend preloads Mesa/Gallium or system opengl32 before any GL imports; select native owner before this call and gate GL provider selection.

init calls selectGLBackend before initWindow, then GL VRAM overrides/info/requirements/driver warnings and self-registered callbacks. Native capability/identity owner must precede callbacks and prevent GL probes; CPU SSE/RAM/input policies remain.

Shutdown stops fetch/cache/decode/thread pools before shutdownGL then viewer window deletion. Native path must cancel/retain producers and drain submitted work before resource/device/window destruction; keyboard remains until views destroyed.

initWindow currently coerces Vulkan to GL, creates LLViewerWindow then pipeline/initGLDefaults with persisted RenderInitError. Replace backend capability/error ownership; preserve startup diagnostics and reference route.

getViewerInfo directly glGetString vendor/renderer/version plus GL VRAM/vendor-based WMI; replace with cached actual Vulkan adapter/driver/backend identity, safe during teardown. CPU/network/library diagnostics remain.
forceErrorDriverCrash calls glDeleteTextures(1,NULL). Legacy crash injection must be gated/disabled/adapted for native backend rather than executing GL with no context.

Constructor immediately creates window, GL shaders, font glyphs, VBO/gGL, feature recommendations and shared-context images before view tree. Split OS/input/CPU view setup from native resource init; retain borrowed window/font/media dependency ordering.

shutdownGL tears down fonts/images/worldmap/selection then stopGL/gGL/VBO and destructor destroys window. Native shutdown needs explicit producer/completion/resource ordering; existing GL destructor behavior is not generic recovery.

reshape updates CPU camera/aspect/UI scale, atlas resolution generation, UI viewport/tree, sim shape/settings; native extent changes must recreate attachments/swapchain without losing CPU coordinate/font invalidation behavior.

stopGL pauses decoding and destroys multiple world/UI/target/shader owners; restoreGL asserts and is explicitly deprecated. Catalog must expose generation retirement and restart/error policy, not presume full device-loss restoration exists.

Feature table parser uses CPU named masks; benchmark SEH calls GPU sandbox and shader finishProfile on failure. Backend-aware benchmark/profile gate and capabilities needed, preserving CPU feature table policy.

loadGPUClass selects driver-specific GL workaround and bandwidth benchmark, stores raw GL GPU identity, graphicsIdentityChanged passes false native flag. Replace identity/capabilities/benchmark policy with actual selected backend; keep CPU/RAM quality bias.

applyBaseMasks maps vendor/GLversion/texture units/varyings/VRAM and mutates Intel GL fallback plus image-worker flags. These GL assumptions must not enable or disable Vulkan capabilities; native queried feature/format/limits policy separate.

Startup notifications compare graphics identity and then hardcode saved LastGraphicsRendererFamily=OpenGL. Persist actual backend family/adapter and preserve intended settings reset notification policy.
Renderer refresh/commit/restart callbacks coerce every non-Zink choice to OpenGL. Enable supported native choices only after renderer availability, preserving pending/committed restart semantics.

Viewer selects SDL2 by default, SDL1 conditionally, Win32 per platform and Darwin separately. llwindow links llrender/glext/SDL; native backend should isolate selected context path while retaining GL reference. BUILD_HEADLESS separate optional target.
Tracy configuration sets OpenGL profiler flag unconditionally; backend-specific compile/runtime profiling required, CPU profiler unaffected.
GPU macros expand Tracy OpenGL API under flag, hidden GL execution across caller files. Native path must replace/gate GPU macros, preserving CPU diagnostics.
